moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off this Friday, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry City
angles.copy: North London's ready! Arsenal begin their title defence at home against Coventry City on Friday. Can they start strong?

angles.name: New Season, New Hopes
angles.copy: From newly promoted teams to title contenders, the Premier League season is a fresh start for all. What's your bold prediction?

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's leading electronic dance music festivals, takes place in Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-30, featuring acts like Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto, and Becky Hill.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is ON! Creamfields 2026 kicks off next week in Daresbury. Who are you buzzing to see on the lineup?

angles.name: Festival Lineup Highlights
angles.copy: From Swedish House Mafia to Tiësto and Becky Hill, Creamfields is bringing the biggest names in dance music. Get ready for an epic weekend!

angles.name: Last Minute Tickets
angles.copy: Still time to grab those last-minute tickets for Creamfields! Four days of world-class DJs and immersive production await. Who's going?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Buzz
